checks: Co-Pilot migration applies after the existing migrations and is repeatable
browser members cannot write connector tables or call service RPCs
confirmed reply, contact state and follow-up task commit in one transaction
duplicate event retries are idempotent even with an old workspace revision
stale new events fail without inserting a message or task
message deltas cannot change fulfillment status, quantities or customer access
invalid task ownership rolls back its message, contact and date changes
invalid task status is rejected by the existing task guard atomically
an event cannot be replayed against another order
members can retain connector evidence during ordinary edits but cannot forge, edit or delete it
manual records remain explicitly unverified when synced from the browser
an unrelated account cannot read private communications, threads, jobs or alerts
outreach leases are durable and repeated claims cannot concurrently send twice
old uncertain outreach is held for delivery review after the provider window
urgency alerts are revision-bound and stale scans cannot overwrite current state
bounded background scan claims prevent overlapping repeated organization scans
existing editor cancellation restrictions still hold with Co-Pilot installed
method: Isolated PGlite PostgreSQL with synthetic organizations and users. No live database or email.
